sections.content: Responsive design adapts to screen size: fluid units (%, rem, vw), media queries (@media), flexible images (max-width:100%), and mobile-first thinking.
Breakpoints target content needs, not devices — design for small screens first, then enhance upward.
Key points: viewport meta enables media queries on mobile, clamp() fluidly scales values, and container queries now style by parent size.
Summary: Responsive Design — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
